guitar.guitaristsText: Keith Richards / Ronnie Wood / Mick Taylor
guitar.modelsText: Fender Telecaster ('Micawber', 5-string open-G) / Gibson Les Paul / ES series
guitar.evidence: Keith Richards' 5-string open-G-tuned Telecaster 'Micawber' is one of the most famous specific guitars in rock history; this justifies high rather than medium confidence.
guitar.notes: Upgraded confidence from medium to high due to Richards' very specifically documented guitar/tuning setup.

tone.target: raw Stones country-rock crunch with slight fuzz
tone.profile: raw Stones country-rock crunch with slight fuzz
tone.summary: The chain uses a Green OD for punchy rhythm tone, followed by Distortion for the required gritty edge and slight fuzz. This is paired with the UK 45 amp model and US 2x12 cab to capture the Tele-style, mid-focused sound of classic Stones country-rock.
corrections: replace generic blues rock with Stones grit
favor dry rhythm over lead gain
